title: Nominalisation and compound adjectives
instructions: Complete the second sentence so it means the same as the first. Write only the missing words.

items.q:
The government decided to cut taxes, which surprised analysts.
The government's ______ taxes surprised analysts.

Prices rose rapidly, which led to lower demand.
The rapid ______ prices led to lower demand.

The company failed because it was badly managed.
The company's failure was due to ______.

We signed a contract for two years.
We signed a ______ contract.

The station is a walk of ten minutes from here.
The station is a ______ walk from here.

The CEO resigned suddenly, and this shocked investors.
The CEO's ______ shocked investors.

They analysed the results carefully.
They carried out a ______ the results.

Unemployment has increased significantly.
There has been a ______ unemployment.

title: Relative clauses
instructions: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: He forgot my birthday again, ______ really upset me.
The colleague ______ laptop was stolen has reported it to the police.
The person to ______ I spoke was very helpful.
Forty people applied for the job, most of ______ were unqualified.
We were offered three options, none of ______ was acceptable.
My manager, ______ has worked here for 20 years, is retiring.
That's the café ______ we first met.
It's a company ______ profits have doubled in two years.
The reason ______ I called is to ask about the invoice.
She passed all her exams, ______ was a huge relief for her parents.

title: Future forms
instructions: Complete with the correct future form of the verb in brackets, or ONE word.

items.q: This time tomorrow I ______ (fly) to Buenos Aires.
By Friday we ______ (finish) the first draft.
By 2030 I ______ (work) here for ten years.
Quick - the film is ______ to start!
The new CEO is ______ to arrive at 10 a.m. (it's on the official schedule)
Electricity prices are ______ to rise by 15% next year, according to experts.
Don't lend him money - he's ______ to forget to pay you back. (it's certain)
After weeks of disagreement, the talks are on the ______ of collapse.
I ______ (call) you last night, but I fell asleep. (a plan that didn't happen)
______ you be using the car this evening? I'd like to borrow it.

title: Hedging: make the claim more careful
instructions: Rewrite each over-certain claim using the hedging tool in brackets.

items.q: Prices will rise next year. (likely)
a: Prices are likely to rise next year.
Prices will likely rise next year.

items.q: This proves that the campaign worked. (would seem to)
a: This would seem to suggest that the campaign worked.
This would seem to show that the campaign worked.

items.q: The policy failed. (appear)
a: The policy appears to have failed.
It appears that the policy failed.

items.q: Young people prefer to work from home. (tend)
a: Young people tend to prefer working from home.
Young people tend to prefer to work from home.

items.q: The merger will create jobs. (may well)
a: The merger may well create jobs.

items.q: Remote work reduces productivity. (some evidence)
a: There is some evidence to suggest that remote work reduces productivity.
There is some evidence that remote work reduces productivity.

items.q: The new system is better. (arguably)
a: The new system is arguably better.
Arguably, the new system is better.

items.q: Customers are unhappy with the price. (to some extent)
a: To some extent, customers are unhappy with the price.
Customers are unhappy with the price to some extent.

title: Mixed-structure cloze (email)
instructions: Write the missing word(s) for each numbered gap in the email above.

items.q: (1) ______ (we / know) how unreliable the supplier was...
(2) Not until the Tuesday ______ we realise...
(3) ______ we should have done was check the contract terms...
(4) ______ (warn) twice by the logistics team...
(5) The supplier, ______ contract expires in March...
(6) is ______ to ask for an extension (= planned / scheduled)
(7) and the board is ______ to refuse (= it's certain)
(8) By the end of the month we ______ (find) an alternative
(9) next quarter's results ______ well improve
(10) ______ you have any questions, please let me know.
